The developed information system will facilitate the work of endocrinologists so that doctors can use not only their own knowledge, but also the world's knowledge for correct treatment of diabetes. Authors demonstrated initial stage of research work, where the choice of platform is a service of the information system for cloud technology is described.

articleTitle: Research of the Combustion Process in a Heat Generator with Ansys Fluent
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The article provides a numerical simulation of the combustion of natural gas (100% methane). Two fuel delivery options are considered. Graphs showing the dependence between nitrogen oxides and the method of supplying fuel and its consumption are presented. Contours of velocities and temperature dependences are presented. The analysis showed that the fuel supply along the height of the v-gutter flameholders leads to a decrease in the formation of nitrogen oxides, compared with the supply from the bottom. The average difference is 16.5% over the entire range of fuel consumption. The temperature difference is 4%. The big difference is explained by the exponential dependence between nitrogen oxides and temperature.

articleTitle: Fostering the innovative university student-centred learning by application of ICT tools together with stakeholders: a project methodology overview
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper represents overview and results from an applied project methodology, focused on Student-Centred Learning (SCL) Practices fueled with ITC-tools and university - industry cooperation, within the Erasmus+ project “InoLearn4BEEs”, Grant Agreement: 2017-1-RO01-KA203-037145. As a part of the approach, an empirical study is performed in four European countries (Romania, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Poland) with local stakeholders from different type and sectors in order to identify their view for real-life problems of their Business/industry sector, to evaluate relevant achievements in the sector, and to identify challenges and opportunities for future development. This is needed for improving and adapting the learning processes in the fields of Business Education and Engineering and Entrepreneurship Education in higher education in line with the digital transformation, that goes together with intensified international and intercultural cooperation. The presented pilot results from Bulgaria and Slovakia help to identify solutions for improving the SCL approach's structure and content, focused on overcoming barriers in front business start and growth by applying precise solutions and strategies.

articleTitle: Lean Startup and Agile for Addressing Educational Challenges
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper aims at exploring the possible knowledge transfer from the business concepts Lean Startup and Agile, usually applied for innovation, project and product management, now for addressing educational challenges as well. Educational challenges are broadly treated as social and human progress related topics rather than project or product-based initiatives. Following the concept of problem-driven innovation approach, the paper analyzes the contribution and potential benefits of applying Lean Startup and Agile for addressing and solving educational challenges on individual level. The methodology developed in the study can be used from universities and schools for identification and realization of effective educational projects, relevant to their unique internal and external environment as well as bearing in mind local and global challenges. It enables a better comprehension of some potential benefits and challenges of applying Lean startup in educational organizations for the purposes of innovation management and management in general.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Maintenance of Medical Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This article presents practical suggestions and analyzes resulting from years of research into the reliability of electronic systems. The research aimed to identify the reasons for the insufficiently high reliability of these systems at the stage of their operation. The focus of the article is on improving the maintenance strategies for electronic systems used in medicine. To evaluate the effectiveness of the concept applied to maintain operational reliability are proposed new criteria. The relevant analytical formulas are derived for this purpose.

articleTitle: A study of the energy - performance indicators of a machine - tractor aggregate for vertical mulching by importing organic matter in the soil
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: A special device for importing organic matter in the soil has been developed in Bulgaria for the purposes of the soil protection method of vertical mulching with ready - made compost. This device is aggregated with tractors with a nominal pulling capacity of 50 kN (John Deere 8230). The effective use of this tractor aggregate has made it necessary to perform a thorough study of some energy - performance indicators. The present article presents the results from this study. The findings prove that the selected energy - performance indicators of the aggregate for vertical mulching with ready - made compost permit its effective use and guarantee optimal pulling and speed work modes on sloping terrains of carbonate chernozems (black soil).

articleTitle: Validation and ordering test for an formula of soil tillage draft force, extended to the dependence on soil moisture
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The article presents results regarding a possibility of extending Goriacikin's soil tillage draft force formula. The extension tries to include in the formula the influence of soil moisture. Some comments are made on the problem of optimum working moisture of the machines intended for soil works. Similar extension procedures are suggested for other formulas of the soil draft tillage force. For a first verification of the results, reference is made to several works in the literature, which present experimental data that include the behaviour of soil tillage draft force to soil moisture.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Development of Activity Monitoring Systems for Small Scale Dairy Farms
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Recent advancements in computer science have made Information and Communication Technology (ICT) systems as a necessary pre-requisite for management in the dairy industry. For this reason, many automated dairy recording systems have been developed and applied in large dairy farms. However, the utilization of computerized recording systems by small scale farms is not widely adopted. As a result, efficiency, effectiveness and competitiveness is relatively at low levels. For this purpose a survey is carried out on small scale farms in Cyprus in order to evaluate the current situation and identify any hurdles that prevent the implementation of contemporary ICT solutions. It was shown that among the main reasons for the lack of usage are the high costs for purchasing and installing ICT systems, the complexity of using the systems, and the level of computer literacy needed to carry out basic recording and analysis functions. Therefore, a simple and easy to use computerized data recording and analysis system with the aim to provide a new approach in the record keeping method among small and medium-scale dairy farmers is proposed. Further, the proposed system is expected to have significant effects for reducing greenhouse gas emissions and contribute to combating climate change.

articleTitle: Building integrated solar thermal systems: some few successful examples
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: the building sector is a significant part of the energy consumption in the World. Using renewable energies to supply thermal and electrical needs in a building is an efficient, clean and sustainable solution; the utilization of solar systems is not always realized without a negative architectural impact mainly for thermal ones. One needs to develop techniques that better integrate solar collectors within the building envelope improving the aesthetic appearance in the most cost effective way. This paper presents some examples of building integrated solar thermal systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influences of the Electromagnetic Field Produced by an Electrified Railway Section
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents a method of calculating the self and mutual impedances of the catenary system used in the railway electric traction in Romania followed by an analysis of the influences of the electromagnetic field produced by a section of electrified railway. The paper presents the analysis of the influences of the electromagnetic field produced by the electrified railway on the metallic objects in their vicinity. The study finds its applicability since the design phase of the electrification system. Thus, the obtained results represent information that will be validated by experimental tests in the execution phase regarding the level of electromagnetic influences on the surrounding environment of the electrified railway.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Aeration Process in the Air-Water Interface
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The work theoretically and experimentally investigates the kinetics of air entrained into the water caused by a jet of water falling vertically on the open water surface. A theoretical model of this phenomenon has been developed and verified by experimental tests to evaluate the role of air uptake, its removal through the air-water interface, the expulsion of water droplets from the water surface and the backflow process. The findings of both the theoretical and experimental study of the distribution of the air amount in the water below the air-water interface reveal an agreement between the data.

articleTitle: Environmental Performance of Motorcycle Gasoline Engines
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Due to the health hazards associated with it, air pollution is a significant problem which is gaining increasing research interest. High levels of air pollution can cause serious health problems, including acute respiratory diseases and allergy. In addition to its adverse effects on human health and air, pollution also has a negative impact on animals, vegetation, crops and climate change. This paper aims at analysing idle running parameters of three different motorcycle engines at crankshaft speeds from 1000 rpm to nominal speed. The concentrations of harmful emissions in the exhaust gases are measured, analysed and compared.

articleTitle: Kinetic Parameters of the Extraction of Tannis from Three Nicotiana Species
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The extraction process of tannins from three tobacco species (Nicotiana alata Link&Otto, N. rustica L., N. tabacum L) was investigated. The extraction was carried out with ethanol solvent in concentration 70%, at a temperature 20-60°C and duration 1, 3, 5 and 7 hours. Rate of extraction of tannins, activation energy and the extraction coefficient were calculated. The molecular diffusion coefficient and the effective diffusion coefficient were calculated according to the equations of Wilke-Chang, Stokes-Einstein and Beloborodov for the three tobacco species.

articleTitle: Development of a technological process for the use of lavender waste biomass for energy purposes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The potential of the lavender biomass waste that remains after the production of lavender oil in Bulgaria in recent years has been determined. A technological process for the utilization of lavender biomass was developed. A horizontal flat die pellet press was chosen and the granulation process was optimized. Chemical analysis of lavender waste biomass has been determined. Lavender biomass waste pellets have been produced and the main fuel characteristics have been determined. The technological line makes it possible to recycle lavender waste biomass and use the produced granules for energy purposes.

articleTitle: Chemical composition and biological activity of pennyroyal (Mentha pulegium L.) grown in Turkey
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The chemical composition of the pennyroyal (Mentha pulegium L.) essential oil and extracts, grown in Turkey has been determined. The major components of essential oil (0.37%) obtained by hydrodistillation was found to be oxygenated monoterpenes cis-piperitone epoxide (32.04%) and piperitenone oxide (31.90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). Extracts obtained with 95 and 70% ethanol were also obtained from the pennyroyal leaves which determined the total polyphenol content expressed in gallic acid equivalents (GAE) per gram dry extract weight (dw) and the total flavonoid content expressed as quercetin equivalent (QE) per gram dw. Their content in the extract with 95% ethanol is 20.62 mg GAE/g dw and 5.92 QE/g dw respectively, and in the extract with 70% ethanol 32.55 mg GAE/g dw and 7.75 QE/g dw respectively. The antioxidant activity of the pennyroyal extracts was determined by the method of 2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydra-zyl (DPPH) and a modified method of cupric reducing antioxidant capacity (CUPRAC). The antioxidant activity of 95% ethanol extract is 557.74 mM Trolox® equivalent (TE)/g dw (CUPRAC) and 242.36 mM TE/g dw (DPPH). The 70% ethanol extract showed higher levels of antioxidant activity, the highest being reported in the CUPRAC method (1100.61 mM TE/g dw). The dry leaves are also determined for their content of chlorophyll and carotenoids.

articleTitle: Hybrid Nanocomposite RGO/ZnO as Sensing Material
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This study presents the synthesis and characterization of nanocomposite materials (NCMs) based on zinc oxide (ZnO) and reduced graphene oxide (RGO) used as sensing material (SM) with application in NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> detection at room temperature. The solutions of ZnO nanoparticles with 1 and 10 % (wt. %) of RGO were deposited onto the interdigitated array electrode forming IDE type sensors. The sensors were tested in 1, 3, 5 and 10 ppm NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> atmosphere, at room temperature and atmospheric pressure. The results prove that the obtained NCMs are suitable for sensing application. NCMs were investigated by DLS, ELS, Raman, UV-Vis and imagistic techniques.

articleTitle: IoT Applications and Protocols: An Air Quality Monitoring Example
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: One of the dominating technologies coming along with the upheaval of wireless communications in the 5G era is the Internet of Things (IoT). Promising to make even the smallest devices like sensors and actuators “smart” and allow them to connect over the network, this technology is associated with a vast number of diverse applications: from smart home, to smart city and smart farming applications, to industrial and healthcare applications. Such an abundance of applications and variety of characteristics poses a serious problem from communication point of view since communication networks so far have been designed and engineered to connect human-to-human (H2H). Large amounts of data are transferred with min delay between well-defined end users. The new paradigm of M2M communications envisages connecting many billions of anonymous devices, for probably only a few kbps or keep devices connected for very long periods of time in unattended, unreachable areas where they have to survive on their limited power supply. Existing communication protocols and architectures are mostly unsuitable for this new type of communications. So, in the last decade we have seen a lot of research and standardization work in designing network protocols that will suit the needs of IoT. In this paper we discuss the characteristics of M2M communications, the protocols suitable to IoT systems and present an example application for air quality monitoring realized in Turkey.

articleTitle: Human Errors Simulator in Substations of Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper describes the development of a realistic simulator of a 20 kV substation for the training of personnel to work in the substations of the power supply systems. The implementation allows easy orientation and memorization of the sequence of actions that the learner should perform in the event of an emergency.

articleTitle: Chellenges to create “new entrepreneurs” by intergenerational family businesses at the University of Ruse “Angel Kanchev”
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The family businesses could be one of the solutions of the job replacements under Industry 3.0 and Industry 4.0. Therefore, in 2018 and 2019 more than 25 scientists from 12 universities in 6 countries did comparative research within the INTERGEN international academic network. This paper presents some of their results with direct relation to the educational challenges to “new generation entrepreneurs” at the University of Ruse “Angel Kanchev”.

articleTitle: Monitoring the quality of services provided in a telecommunication network by analyzing the statistics of PPPoE packets
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Currently the Internet supports the simultaneous use of audio, video and data transfer within one channel (connection). To achieve this, a guaranteed absence of packet loss is required, which, in turn, is highly dependent on congestion control. This article discusses options for monitoring the quality of services and presents alternatives to the generally accepted ones. Methods introducing new protocols are described along with their pros and cons. Considering that for large telecom operators the monitoring of the quality of services provided is an important component of a stable business, the regarded issue is topical and requires new approaches at minimal cost. This paper proposes a method for monitoring the traffic quality by analyzing the statistics of PPPoE (Point-to-point protocol over Ethernet) packets which are already on the equipment at the biggest Internet Service Provider of the Republic of Kazakhstan - JSC “Kazakhtelecom”. The paper proposes types of PPPoE packets that help indirectly determine the quality of services provided and a method for processing PPPoE packets statistics; results obtained during the tests are demonstrated as well.

articleTitle: Modelling of Fuel Cell and Supercapacitor for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the current research a mathematical model of an electric vehicle supplied by fuel cell and supercapacitor is proposed. The model takes as input standard electric vehicle provided by the manufacturer that is needed for the power conversion system. The main purposes of this model is to be used in order the designed to be able to define the optimal energy flows between two different supplying elements in electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Reducing the Toxicity of Diesel Engines Due to Two-Phase Fuel Injection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Protecting the environment from diesel emissions requires immediate operational forecasting and solutions encompassing a mixture of organizational and technical measures and other effective actions. The article deals with the issue of reducing the toxicity of diesel engines, which can be achieved with the conversion to gaseous fuel. Of scientific interest is also what amount of gaseous fuel additive would be effective in two-phase fuel supply without worsening the technical characteristics. This issue is especially relevant for agricultural transport equipment, as closer to the time of harvest in autumn, diesel prices increase. The experimental stand allows the D-144 engine to change the additive of gaseous fuel from 0 to 30 % of the total fuel consumption. Fuel consumption and the associated excess air ratio have the best values near q = 20% (the decrease in air consumption when additional fuel is supplied to the inlet is between 0+5 %). Analysis of literature conducted shows that two-phase fuel supplies improve the environmental characteristics of diesel and the greatest effect is achieved when the gaseous fuel is around 20%. This reduces NOx emissions and smokiness.

articleTitle: Influence of a slotted flap gap size on the aerodynamic characteristics of a light aircraft wing at taking off and landing
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to examine the impact of the gap size of a slotted flap on the aerodynamic characteristics of a light aircraft wing at take-off and landing. All surveys in the paper are numerical, executed in Ansys Fluent, using transient analysis and dynamic mesh method. The models used are 2 dimensional. Statements are made for the aerodynamic efficiency of a wing with a slotted flap, depending on the slot size. Optimal gap size is defined, for a specific wing configuration. Comparisons between the different slotted flap configurations and a plain flap wing design are made. The main goal of this study is the evaluation of the gap size of a slotted flap wing design upon the aerodynamic efficiency and determination of an optimal gap size for the examined wing.

articleTitle: Influence of an integrated battery system over the annual grid consumption for a hybrid decentralized system
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper describes a research regarding the possible influence of an integrated battery system over the total annual grid consumption of hybrid decentralized systems for electrical and thermal power supply. Various system structures, based on simulations models have been developed and observed. Their purpose is to estimate the possible annual amount of electrical energy consumed from utility grid, while their structures include various sizes of power generators. All systems are designed to provide a residential neighborhood with both electrical and thermal power supply with an active link to the power distribution grid. According to their structure they might consist of combinations with two or more decentralized generators from conventional and renewable type or purely renewable type. Several of the most promising cases for system structures, regarding their power supply potential have been selected and best performing cases are investigated further.

articleTitle: Influence of Soil Fertilization Systems and Crop Rotation on Physical and Chemical Properties of the Soil
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The scope of the paper has been to determine the effect of soil fertilizers -90 kg N/ha, 75 kg N/ha, N90P75 kg/ha, farmyard manure, on the chemical and physical properties (resistance to penetration, humidity and total nitrogen) of the soil. The samples were obtained from a research institute - Romanian National Agricultural Research and Development Institute - Fundulea. From the total evaluated concentrations we can mention the total nitrogen content lowest values recorded in the case a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>b<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, respectively 1.12 mg/kg d. m. The higher humidity content in soil (14 %) has been recorded for soil case a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>b<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>- WD2.

articleTitle: Simulation of Starting Modes of Double Star Ship's Synchronous Propulsion Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: More and more ships are using electric propulsion systems - cruise ships, marine platforms, suppliers. The power of the electrical propulsion motor reaches tens of megawatts. In addition, they are controlled by converters. One effective solution is to use a double star electrical motor for electrical propulsion. Using the original model, the article simulated transients in normal operating modes. Simulation results are given. Process analysis done.

articleTitle: Investigation the Influence of the Active Resistance Value in the Neutral and the Transient Resistance of Earth Faults in Medium Voltage Electrical Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The neutral of the medium voltage power transformer on the medium voltage side in medium voltage grids is most often earthed through an active resistance or through a combination from a reactor and an active resistance. The determining factors for choosing the grounding method are the value of the single phase to earth fault current, the transient overvoltages, the selectivity and sensitivity of the earth relay protection, the electrical safety and more. The paper researches the influence of the value of the active resistance included in the neutral of the power transformer and the transient resistance in the fault place on the regime parameters for single phase to earth faults in medium voltage electrical grid.

Author Keywords: single phase to earth fault current

articleTitle: Near-time Optimal Control of a System with Quazistationary Switching Line
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper focuses on the time-optimal and near-time optimal control of a system with quazistationary switching line. Near-time optimal control is realized by fuzzy logic or neural approximation of the optimal switching line. The processes in the near-time optimal systems are compared with these from optimal control system in cases of changing the object's and reference's parameters. In the case of a fuzzy model of the switching line, the change in the object's and reference's parameters had the least significant influence on the shape and duration of transient responses. The energy consumption of the systems is evaluated by the integrated square of the control action. The energy consumption in the time-optimal systems is smaller than these in the near-time optimal systems.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Performance of Small-Scale Wind Turbine Rotors
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the research regarding the development and testing of small-scale wind turbine rotors, as well as aspects regarding their integration in power systems. Different wind rotors with diameters ranging from 524 mm to 620 mm have been designed in order to study the influence of the main parameters such as rotor diameter, blade chord length and pitch angle on the power output. The models have been made by 3D printing and were characterized by testing performed in an open circuit wind tunnel. For 10 m/s wind velocity, the maximum power output of the developed rotors is in the range of 34...48W. The experimental results revealed that the lower the pitch angle, the higher the starting velocity, turbine power, rotational speed and power coefficient.

articleTitle: Energy and cost -efficient air flow measurement solution for small scale processes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The implementation of an affordable but reliable method for air flow measurement is described in this paper. For the best result, determining the properties of the airflow in the main air pipe where done by using the most cost-efficient methods. Implementing the modelling with software coupled with mathematical modeling of the process to verify the superlative flow properties will reduce the price of the final setup. The following methods used through the research project: fundamental study of air-flow quantities and air-flow principles with cost-effective MEMS (Micro Electro-Mechanical Systems) - sensors. Designing the flow measurement extension in “Autodesk Invertor” and installing it into the existing system. Simulating the projected air flow in CFD “Computational Fluid Dynamics” simulation software. “Autodesk-CFD” testing of the simulated results. Sample modeling and producing a mathematical prototypical based model on the test results using the “non-linear regression analysis method” to determine the connection in sensor's output and actual flow in the main duct. Confirming the connection between the simulation outcomes, trial results, and scientific model. The simulation through the CFD PC application is a modern and cost-cost-effective technique of designing an optimum model for the flow property research. The usage of the Computational Fluid Dynamics knowingly cuts the prototyping phase of research and conserves resources. Mathematical modeling, that is built on both simulating figures and experimental results, gives precise knowledge of the flow development, and can be used in the future expansion of the flow control software. The use of MEMS - sensors, when those are properly adjusted, is a reliable and energy efficient technique for measuring airflow in small scale processes.

articleTitle: Research of the Formation of Nitrogen Oxides During the Burning of Ekibastuz Coal
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the experiment, the influence of the shift of the oxidant feed on the processes of formation of nitrogen oxides was studied. In order to do so, a vertical tubular furnace with electric heating was used. The flow of dust of Ekibastuz coal in all experiments was kept constant to 0.042 g/s, the grinding factor was 18% and the excess air ratio 1,2. The temperature in the furnace varied from 500°C to 700°C at an 11% oxygen concentration inside. As a result of the experiments, it is shown that by pyrolysis of coal dust from Ekibastuz coal at temperatures of 500-700°C and the delay of time of air supply to the combustion zone by 0.1 s, under experimental conditions, we were able to reduce the concentration of nitrogen oxides by 3 times, including a 1.25 and 1.9 times reduction due to pyrolysis at temperatures ranging from 500 to 700°C, in addition to a 2.7 and 1.9 times reduction owing to the delay of the air supply introduced. As a result of calculations and experiments, it was shown that the greatest reduction in NOx is achieved by supplying secondary air after the completion of the initial stage of gasification before ignition of volatile ones.

articleTitle: Maintenance Strategies Where the Moment in Which Next in Line Preventive Repair of the Medical Apparatus Will Begin, is Known in Advance
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this article, we have focused on some aspects of maintenance, and we have calculated the quantitative reliability indicators for different maintenance strategies. For this purpose, we have offered new analytical formulas by which to compare the effect of the application of one or another strategy for maintenance. The article also provides some data on the application of these formulas. They assessed the effect of the application of different strategies on some types of technical systems.

articleTitle: SARMENTI: in-situ real-time soil nutrients and gaseous emission measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents the vision of the H2020 EU SARMENTI project that develops an IoT node that monitors in place and in real-time soil nutrients and emission of gasses above the ground, and provide recommendations to the farmer regarding appropriate fertilization strategies. The development methodology is presented here, the measurement requirements being established with end-users. Then the device architecture is summarized.

articleTitle: LED Transmitter for Plastic Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Light emitting diodes (LED) are optical transmitters, radiating light in the visible range for plastic optical fibers and finding wide application in automation of technological processes both in industry and building automation. Optical signals are usually emitted by LEDs in the visible range by either laser diodes with lens or collimated lasers. This paper presents the results from experimental studies of a new scheme of an optical transmitter, using a LED, radiating light in the visible range. The aim of the conducted studies is to prove the possibility for transmitting numerical and analogue broad-band signals by using plastic optical fibers. Analysis of both the transient processes and the frequency properties of the transmitter have been made. An equivalent circuit of the optical transmitter, suitable for simulation studies, has been developed. The transient characteristics of the LED transmitter have been shown for operation in a pulse mode. By using an N-channel JFET to control the light emitting diode, connected in a common drain configuration, the r.m.s. value of the noise voltage at the output of the transmitter is reduced. This makes it applicable in systems for transmitting analogue data in addition to digital ones. The transmitter is compatible with the majority of data formats. It can be included as a final element in numerical interfaces for data communication through plastic optical fibers. The reliability of the transmitter in operation is increased by using a small number of elements.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency of intermittent drying regimes of carrot
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of an experimental study of convective intermittent drying of carrots (Daucus carota). The experiments have been grouped in three series according to the duration of the heating period: continuous, symmetrical and asymmetrical. Symmetrical intermittent modes consists equal periods of heating and cooling: 2+2, 4+4, 6+6, 8+8, 10+10 min. Asymmetrical intermittent modes with a heating period that is two times longer: 2+1, 4+2, 6+3, 8+4, 10+5 min. The temperature of the air during the heating period for three groups was 70°C. The influence of different duration of heating periods on energy savings has been investigated. There is a significant reduction in the energy consumption (from 30 to 48.6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) for drying compared to the continuous mode for all the experiments from the group of symmetrical regimes.

articleTitle: Strawberry anthocyanins copigmentation process investigation at different temperatires with appropriate copigment chlorogenic acid
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this study the model system between strawberry anthocyanins and chlorogenic acid was investigated. Pigment:copigment system was observed at different concentration of copigment and in different temperatures. The absorption was determined at heating system from 20 to 50 °C and following cooling the same system from 50 to 20 °C. After this observations was conclude that the pigment:copigment complex destroy at 50 °C and restore again after cooling at 30 °C.

articleTitle: Comparison of Some Variants of Emergency Maintenance Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The research on medical device maintenance presented in this article is based on the definition of several maintenance strategies. Their main characteristics, advantages and disadvantages are formulated. Areas of application are analyzed. The focus is on Emergency maintenance strategies. Quantitative estimators have been created with which help can be evaluated effect of applying one or another form of maintenance. In this way, it is possible to avoid making subjective decisions about the way maintenance is performed.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicles Driving Cost and Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: On the brink of climate changes, many world leaders started talking about transition towards greener technologies. The electric vehicles seem to be the favorite in the transport field. The paper presents a comparative analysis of the current and expected future driving costs and competitiveness of electric vehicles compared to internal combustion engine ones. Our aim is to find out if electric vehicles are indeed able to take over the market from a practical perspective. Their main drawbacks are presented together with available technologies which could overcome them.

articleTitle: Survey of the passive protection on board of the ship against low and high frequency electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The study of the shielding materials used in shipbuilding is an important element both for the protection of electronic systems onboard ships and of the crew against electromagnetic disturbances. By its approach, this paper has as a starting point, a brief presentation of the calculation method for determining the attenuation expression, by reflection and absorption, known as the impedance method, for a common frequency range between 50 Hz and 20 GHz. for both civilian and military vessels. Also, some aspects of the shielding of the near fields (at low frequencies) and of the far-field (at high frequencies) are analyzed. Based on the theoretical study and some of the magnetic and non-magnetic materials properties, several solutions have been proposed in order to reduce the effects of these types of electromagnetic fields.

articleTitle: Feasibility study of irrigation system with wind generator
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility to use wind generator for feeding of irrigation system. The developed methodology uses statistical meteorological data for the considered site and is based on operation simulation for one year period. The meteorological data are converted according to the wind generator hub height and then converted in produced energy using the wind turbine power curve and interpolation method. The methodology is applied to 7 different sites in Bulgaria. The considered agricultural crop is grapevines. Different configurations of wind generator rated power and water tank capacity are considered. The results allow the estimation of the feasibility of this power supply.

articleTitle: Modelling and Optimizing the Tool Life of Zirconia Toughened Alumina Ceramic Cutting Tools during Turning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: There are various methods for producing ceramic materials of enhanced strength properties in view of their application as tool materials: development of new compositions with set properties and new technologies for obtaining them; control of the sintering process and the ceramics microstructure by using some additives. The paper considers the results from a study of the tool life of experimental alumina-based ceramic cutting tools where unstabilized zirconia in quantities from 5 vol. % to 15 vol. % has been used as an additive. In addition, theoretical and experimental models have been developed. They reflect the complex influence of the cutting mode during turning (cutting speed and feed rate) and the percentage of the zirconia additive on the life of tools with square and triangular zirconia-toughened alumina ceramic inserts. By applying single-purpose optimization and a genetic algorithm, the optimal values of the following are defined: cutting speed Vc; feed rate f and percentage of zirconia additive ( A), where the durability of the cutting tools is maximal - Vc=200 m/min, f=0.18 mm/rev, A=15%.

articleTitle: Design and Study of an Automotive Thermoelectric Generator
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the internal combustion engines, regardless of the fuel type they run on, about 60 % of the energy is lost in the form of heat diffracted into the environment. Today, many large companies and research institutes work towards introducing thermoelectric generators into vehicles to utilize the heat generated by their work. The current paper develops and studies a compact thermoelectric generator that converts the temperature difference of working fluids into electromotive force, and is intended for integration into a car. The possibility of utilizing waste heat in the work of the internal combustion engines is been proven.

Author Keywords: Alternative energy source in the car

articleTitle: Study of the operational efficiency indicators of soil - protecting machine - tractor aggregates used for vertical mulching by importing organic matter in the soil
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In Bulgaria, the soil - protection method of vertical mulching by importing organic matter in the soil can be applied by using two agricultural machines, namely a device for importing organic matter in the soil and a modified cutter-dead furrower ShtN-2-140 with a mulch hopper. The performance reliability of these machines is determined by a study of their operational efficiency indicators and the results of this study are presented in the current material. These results show that the two soil - protecting machine - tractor aggregates for vertical mulching by importing ready - made compost in the soil have good exploitation characteristics, which guarantee the timely performance of the agricultural operations on areas with various soil and terrain properties in our country.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling and experimental study of heat transfer processes of a two-phase thermosiphon with complex geometry
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical and numerical model for the processes of heat transfer in a two-phase thermosyphon with complex geometry. Three zones of the air heater are distinguishable - vapor zone, adiabatic zone and condensation zone. The processes are conditionally divided into those that take place in the two-phase thermosyphon and those between the air heater and the two tracts (flue gases and fresh air). The experimental study of the coefficients of heat transfer in the evaporation and condensation zones showed that: hfgas=104.9 and hfgas=84.9 W/(m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>K). A numerical study of this process was also carried out and it was further established that the initial turbulent intensity was not more than 10%. The data obtained for the distribution of the parameters of the two flows in the vicinity of the heater will be useful in modeling the processes in the two-phase thermosyphon.

articleTitle: Water Distribution at Alteration of Flow Regimes with Pressure Flows for Irrigation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the irrigation of agro-cultures, water distribution is one of the main specifics of a given applied technology. Water distribution is most often realized by means of distribution pipelines, feeding water quantities towards the irrigation equipment and elements by means of water divergency. Depending on the exploitation conditions, a flow is therein formed, with lengthwise-variable water quantities. This paper considers hydraulic aspects and conditions of the application of distribution pipelines in irrigation. Proposed are relationships for determination of the boundaries of the self-realizing flow regimes in the pipelines and their border water quantities necessary for dimensioning with a view of providing effective water distribution in irrigation.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Parameters of the Extraction of Three Nicotiana Species
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The thermodynamic parameters - Gibbs free energy, entropy and enthalpy, were calculated for the extraction of tannins from the leaves of three tobacco species (Nicotiana alata Link&Otto, N. rustica L. and N. tabacum L.). The extraction was carried out with ethanol solvent at 30, 50, 70 and 95% concentration, duration of 1, 3, 5 and 7 hours and temperature range from 20 to 60 °C. Those thermodynamic parameters were used to determine the stability of the system and the type of the process of tobacco leaf extraction.

articleTitle: Methodology and Results of the Experiment of The Formation of Nitrogen Oxides in a Powder Torch
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The state of the issue, the main provisions and the results of the computational and graphic comparative analysis of theoretical models of the processes of formation of air and fuel nitrogen oxides are briefly described. The scientific novelty of the work consists of the methodology and experimental results on the influence of pyrolysis and phase shift of the input of coal dust and air on the formation of fuel nitric oxide. In the numerical simulation, the effect parameters such as fuel consumption, fuel temperature and air temperature on the nitrogen oxides' formation processes is investigated. Increasing the concentration of oxygen from 16 to 18% significantly increases both the temperature and the formation of thermal nitrogen.

articleTitle: Development of Load Cycle of Automotive Alternator
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The reliability of the vehicle electrical equipment is determined by the performance of the vehicle alternator, as the main source of electricity on board. Defects in automobile alternator s lead to a decrease in the generated energy, which is characterized by a change in the output voltage and current strength. It is proposed to diagnose the technical condition of an automobile alternator by assessing changes in its parameters during the load cycle. The load cycle of the alternator has been developed for testing it directly on the vehicle. The load cycle includes typical modes of vehicle movement, characterized by a change in the speed of movement and the current strength of consumers, which make it possible to assess the performance of an automobile alternator. The numerical values of the load cycle parameters are obtained when testing a serviceable alternator in a passenger vehicle. Further studies are aimed at determining the numerical values of the cycle corresponding to alternator with the most characteristic faults.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of energization and re-energization overvoltages in overhead transmission line 220 kV
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Operations with circuit breakers and switches in power system causes switching surges. Switching surges due to closing and reclosing operations with breakers could be dangerous for equipment in substations. Determining overvoltage level for the equipment is important for power system reliability. These representative overvoltages are useful for insulation coordination procedure. Due to the nature of the overvoltages statistical distribution of overvoltages for more than one switching operation is needed. This paper present statistical analysis of energization and re-energization overvoltages in overhead transmission line 220 kV due to circuit breaker operation in substation 220 kV. The model study is done with ATP/EMTP software.

articleTitle: Influence of Led Bulbs on Electromagnetic Compatibility Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper inhere describes a study of various types of LED bulbs which are connected to the low-voltage power distribution systems. In that relation, the relevant parameters of electromagnetic compatibility are presented. There have been presented graphically the current curves in the phase and the neutral conductors and their harmonic composition. The performed measurements' results show that LED bulbs and LED luminaires change the harmonic composition of the current curve, which results in increased power and energy losses.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Secondary School Teachers' Opinion about Mobile Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper examines the opinion of 43 secondary school teachers from different schools in Bulgaria about mobile learning. For the purposes of the investigation, a questionnaire was created and used. It includes questions about the respondents (gender, age, owned mobile devices and computers), as well as questions related to e-learning and mobile learning. An analysis of respondents' answers and relevant conclusions are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of the possibilities of using a sulfur-free solid fuel at CET Deva-Romania
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: For Romanian's power plants that use solid fuel as coal, at present the main concern is to comply with emission limits for SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The majority of thermoelectric power stations resorted to the implementation of some Wet Flue Gas Desulfurization (FGD) systems using limestone. After, a solid fuel with a very low sulfur content has appeared on the world fuel market (Sc<; 0.1%). The use of this fuel at CET Deva will appeal only to hammer mills, with drying agent represented only by primary air, at a fairly high temperature of about 300°C. This new fuel that allows integration into SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission limits, however, raises other problems. Thus, the moisture content is very high which implies a strict control of the drying process during the grinding process. The high content of volatile matters, as well as the very low ash content, are positive elements for the ignition and combustion process, but negative for the grinding process, when only air drying can lead to the ignition of the volatiles and thus to the possibility of explosion in the mill. The paper includes an analysis of the following aspects: - the possibility of drying the fuel in the hammer mills only with the help of the primary air; -the possibility of carrying out the grinding operation without ignition of the volatile matters avoiding the explosion in the mill.

articleTitle: Environmental Characteristics of an SI Engine Running on Methane and Gasoline
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The objective of the paper is to study the environmental performance of a gasoline engine operating on methane. The study involves experiments and comparing the results obtained with the parameters of the test running of the same engine on gasoline. Multiple tests have been conducted, thus providing for collecting information about various environmental parameters of the engine operating on methane fuel and gasoline. The results presented were obtained with wide open throttle engine operation, optimal air-fuel ratios and ignition timing.

articleTitle: Some Considerations for the Risk Assessment at Work with Medical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The electrical equipment used for medical purposes can create a number of dangers to the user, the service personnel and the patients. The paper presents some considerations for the risk assessment at work with medical equipment. Specifically, some features that should be considered when assessing electrical hazards for the health and the safe of the patients or users at faults or negligence of safety measures.

articleTitle: Identification of Agricultural Plant Row Using the Clustering Algorithm in the Navigation of Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper describes navigation method usable in agriculture plant row for mobile robot. The proposed method with clustering algorithm uses data obtained by Hokuyo laser sensor. Using the created solution it is possible to determine plant in a row when mobile robot using the local navigation principle. Crops in a row are characteristic waypoints that create the vertices of the polygon. From this polygon the center of gravity is calculated, which determines the center position of the plant row. From this polygon the center of gravity is calculated, which determines the center position of the plant row. This position is used for mobile robot control algorithm. The processed data by scanners provide information not only on waypoints but also on any obstacles in the agricultural plant row.

Author Keywords: identification of crop row laser scanner

articleTitle: Research of the Impact of the Active Driver Circuit with a dv/dt Feedback on the Speed of a DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The main purpose of the present paper is to study the influence of an active driver with a feedback on the voltage derivative on both the speed and the average current value when performing pulse control of a DC motor. Studies with a conventional driver have also been carried out. A comparative analysis of the obtained experimental results has been made. An analysis of the harmonic composition of the voltage applied to the motor armature when controlling the motor by both the active and the conventional driver has been made. The change in the rotational speed of the motor, as well as in the average value of the current through the armature winding as a function of the pulse duty cycle has been studied experimentally. For comparison between the two drivers, oscillograms and results in tabular form are presented.

articleTitle: Switching transients in overhead transmission line 220 kV
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Power system is exposed to overvoltages due to different reasons. Switching overvoltages are one of common causes of outages and damages in the system. Switching overvoltages are caused by circuit breaker operations. These operations are classified as closing and reclosing. Overhead line energization and de-energization causes switching surges. These surges under certain conditions can be dangerous for the facilities in the power substations. Therefore the knowledge of overvoltage levels and the factors affecting them is important for power system reliability. In this paper switching overvoltages due to closing and re-closing operations of overhead power line 220 kV are investigated through model study. ATP-EMTP software is used for power system modeling. Case studies without using surge arresters and with surge arresters are reviewed in the paper. Overvoltages in different location on overhead line are shown.

articleTitle: Reducing Energy Losses in Realising MOSFET Control by an Active du/dt Feedback Driver
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents a method and a device for active control of power transistors, operating in a switch mode. The achieved goals are related to reduction of the dynamic energy losses when controlling the key elements. The driver circuitry limits the electromagnetic radiation, eliminates the need of using RC protection groups and increases the operational reliability of power transistors. An analytical model of the studied driver scheme has been made and results from the conducted experimental studies during the MOSFET control have been given. A comparison with a commonly used driver scheme has been drawn up.

articleTitle: GNSS for Accuracy Positioning in Mobile Communications with Multipath Propagation of the Signal
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper deals with the influence of multipath propagation of transmitted signal, causing additional peaks in the correlation function of the received signals. Also, the multipath adds distortion in the receiving signal and hence an error in determining the exact position of the user equipment. The presence of multipath propagation reduces the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the received signal, leading to an increase in the synchronization error. The characteristics of navigation signals and multipath propagation errors are analyzed. A theoretical study of multipath error envelope are conducted.

articleTitle: Determination of the Electrical Field Intensity Affecting a Person Situated under the Phase Conductor of a High Voltage Power line
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: When a person is under strong electric field he is not only feeling uncomfortable, but also is exposed to serious hazards (disturbances in the central nervous system, heart, blood system, etc.). On this basis norms and regulations are being developed, that treat the relation between the strength of the electric field and the time of exposition without protection. There have been worked out analytical dependences that allow evaluation of the electric field strength according to the geometrical dimensions of the power lines and the transmitted voltage. Especially actual is the question about staying under the power lines while dealing with agricultural activities, staying of people and animals near high and ultrahigh-voltage equipment.

articleTitle: Assesment of sound pressure levels using experimental and numerical modelling of a complex office space
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This article presents a numerical and experimental campaign for the measurements and prediction of the sound pressure levels inside an office space. The measurements were realized in multiple points and the analysis was realized for all frequency range (31 Hz to 8 kHz). The main source of noise was found to be the HVAC system and improvements to it were needed. A complex 3D model was created for simulation purposes and to test several noise proof solutions. The initial simulations were first validated with the experimental data and afterwards a soundproof solution was simulated. This study shows how a complex indoor space geometry can be simulated and validated with experimental data.

articleTitle: Kinetic parameters investigation at reaction of pigment:copigment complex between quercetin and strawberry anthocyanins
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The stability between anthocyanin extract of strawberry and quercetin as pigment:copigment couple of temperature evaluation was investigated. A couple temperatures and concentrations of copigment were used for the investigation there interactions. Rate constant of copigmentation reaction was found. Some kinetic parameters degradation rates, z factor and activation energy Ea were calculated. At high temperatures, to 50 °C obtained complex destroyed and at 20 °C after cooling the complex was not restored again according the calculations. In this system do not observed reversibil of the copigmentation process.

articleTitle: Kinematic modelling of the tracking system for parabolic trough collector
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Sun is the main source of renewable energy. Sun energy can be transformed into thermal energy or electric energy by using solar collectors of trough type. These collectors are provided with mono - axial tracking systems. The paper presents the kinematic modeling of a tracking system with linkages driven by three linear actuators. The following independent parameters are considered to determine the actuators strokes: the rotation angle of the trough collector, the transmission angle and the constant stroke of one actuator.

articleTitle: Increasing energy efficiency of a gas boiler using remote access control
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper describes a system for gas boiler remote control which is an alternative to the frequently used wireless thermostat for gas boilers. It is possible that these two controllers are working together or one by one in independent mode. This system is very personal compared to what is available on the markets.

articleTitle: Studies and Researches Regarding the Influence of the Size of Solid Particles Forming a Heterogenous Mix on the Aerodynamic Separation Process
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This article presents a study carried out under laboratory conditions, aiming to identify the efficiency of the aerodynamic separation process. Within this process, a heterogeneous mix was used, carried out in two steps, according to the size of the particles, fraction 1 with a diameter d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>=1.75 mm and fraction 2 with a diameter d2=1.16 mm. Five mixes have been made with these fractions, within which the share of the components varied as following: 80 % d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> - 20 % d2; 65 % d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> - 35 % d2; 50 % d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> - 50 % d2; 35 % d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> - 65 % d2; 20 % d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> - 80 % d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Also, the air flow passing through the installation used for the aerodynamic separation process varied as following: 0.028 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s; 0.034 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s; 0.04 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s; 0.044 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s and 0.049 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s. Following the aerodynamic separation processes, it is concluded that this process is directly influenced by the structure of solid particles heterogeneous mix and by the value of the air flow passing through the installation. It is also concluded that, for a most efficient separation of fraction 1 in the mix, predominantly collecting in collecting container 1, its share must be 80 % and the air flow 0.028 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s. For the second component in the mix, collected in collecting container 3 of the laboratory stand, its share must be 80 % and the air flow 0.049 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s.

articleTitle: Recent Trends in FMEA Methodology
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper intends to present the latest trends in one of the most popular methods for risk analysis- the Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA). The application of FMEA in the automotive industry has been significantly modified in the summer of 2019. This necessitates the elaboration of a transition methodology supported by appropriate training and practical implementation in industry.

articleTitle: Multi-fuel Autonomous Electric Generating Unit with Stabilization System of the Output Voltage
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents the structural scheme and design of a multi-fuel autonomous power generating unit based on a low-boiling coolant and a rotary vane expansion machine. The developed power generating unit works with any type of fuel as well as with low-potential sources of thermal energy. Studies of operating modes of an autonomous power generating unit using a simulation model, developed in the Matlab/Simulink, showed the possibility of obtaining a stable output voltage without using an inverter when the load and parameters of the thermal part were changing. Calculations were carried out to determine the power generation efficiency of the proposed unit. They showed that the cost of generated electricity with using the developed unit is much lower compared to using a diesel generator.

articleTitle: A Software Tool for Accuracy Evaluation of Calculated Similarity Factors between Papers and Reviewers
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The assignment of reviewers to papers is one of the most important and challenging tasks in organizing scientific conferences. Its accuracy has a direct impact on the quality and the fairness of the review process. The accuracy of the automatic assignment depends on both the assignment algorithm and the way similarity factors between papers and reviewers are calculated. This paper proposes an architecture and a working model of a software tool for accuracy evaluation of the calculated similarity factors between papers and reviewers. It has been used over a hundred times and proved to be very useful for evaluation and comparative analysis of existing methods of describing papers and reviewers' competences.

Author Keywords: methods of describing papers and reviewers' competences

articleTitle: An Approach for Building of Radar Sensor Networks for Observation of UAVs
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Today small aircrafts, helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) find many applications in all spheres of activity of contemporary society. Unfortunately, in many cases UAVs are exploited by criminal groups for illegal activities. Accounting this situation an approach for building of radar sensor networks for observation and tracing UAVs is substantiated in the paper. Its most significant features are: a very good electromagnetic compatibility with all other radio communication systems (RCSs), simultaneous working, small cost and great density, which allow the UAVs to be observed and traced effectively.

articleTitle: Environmental Management: Global Threats and Key Determinants
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Global threats are uncertain events and, if deported, can have a significant negative impact on countries and industries over the next ten years. It is important to note uncertainties in the assessment of future conditions, in particular, those related to environmental change. The study shows that the possibility of integrating into the macroeconomic model of the world economy can take place under different scenarios, but important in the long run are scenarios that take into account the impact of global environmental change and encourage society to study their impact on social adaptation and economic development. The conceptual framework for designing requires the development of global pathways for the future evolution of key aspects of society: demography, human development, economics and lifestyles, politics and institutions, technologies, the environment and natural resources. Country's sustainability level is determined by its overall efficiency in three levels of sustainability: social, environmental and economic; therefore, it is considered important to identify key determinants of these problems at the level of the major world regions, which can serve as the basis for comprehensive emission scenarios and land use, as well as for the analysis of the impact on climate, adaptation, and vulnerability.

articleTitle: Overview of Diagnostic Methods for Rotating Electrical Machines
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Rotating electrical machines (generators and motors) are the basic elements of modern electrical power systems. Their control, maintenance and diagnostics are an urgent task. The article provides a classification and review of diagnostic methods for machines. The main attention is paid to the choice of input signals, mathematical methods for extracting useful information and diagnostics of electric drives in static and transient modes.

articleTitle: Filtration Theory and Techniques. A Short Review on the Filtration Process
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the present paper it was put into discussion some aspects related to the water and wastewater treatment by using filtration. It was evaluated the procedure and technics used in the water treatment and the predictability to apply some conditions in the case of ultrafiltration. Also, it was evidenced the advantages and disadvantages of each filtration methods.
